title: Richard S
content: I was in my hospital room and kept hearing the speaker system announce "Code blue, room number XXX." I remember going to sleep, thinking about how my practice would be affected by being off for a few days and going over our finances. I must have fallen asleep. Then I was lying in bed, hearing the code blue alert and thinking there were a lot of code blues that night. I sat up, looked around the room, and heard "Code blue, room number XXX." I think it was room 289; I'm not sure. I realized, "289? That's my room number." I sat up in bed, wondering what was going on. Then suddenly, I was floating in the hallway and moving upward. I wondered how I got there. As I floated, four people with a wheeled chart entered what I assumed was my hospital room. While I was still floating up, I was still questioning how this was happening. I saw a rush of memories and realized my chronic back pain was gone. I felt no pain at all. I realized that I must be dead. I thought about unfinished things such as paying off the house and regarding my family. But I kept floating. I said, "God, I can't die. I have too much left to do." Then I pleaded, "God, I can't die. Marissa will be devastated." I kept floating. I thought of my wife, who is 21 years younger than me. "God, my wife needs me. I have to live to support my family and help her with our daughters." I floated upwards some more. Then it struck me that my two-year-old daughter would be without her father. I prayed, "God, don't let me die, my baby daughter needs her father." The question came again: "Why should you live?" I replied, "My baby daughter needs her dad." Asked once more, I repeated, "My baby daughter needs her dad. I beg you in Jesus's name, let me live so I can be there for her." I started descending. A tunnel of gray clouds appeared, and I rushed through it at incredible speed. The tunnel dipped downward before rising again, and ahead I saw a brilliant light. Entering the light, I suddenly gasped for air and opened my eyes to painful brightness. A nurse told me that I had been intubated for a week in a medically induced coma. They gave me pudding to eat but I was still restrained and desperately thirsty. Water was withheld because my heart retained too much fluid. While in and out of consciousness, I kept hearing, "Why should you live?" and answering, "my baby daughter needs her dad." Weeks passed before I regained strength, and some mental fog lingered. I believe I’m alive because my baby daughter needs her father.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain, Illness, Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I felt out of my body and knew I was not in a normal situation. It lasted about two minutes, but I was in a coma for a week.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, Things happened very fast.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: It was clear without my eyeglasses.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes, It looked like a tunnel made of clouds. I went down into the tunnel, then traveled up into a bright light.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain, As I ascended in the tunnel, I saw a bright light and then woke up.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt confused; then peace and no pain. I realized I was dead and feared my family would be devastated by my death.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: It was like a flash of past experiences.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life, I begged God to let me live so my youngest daughter could grow up with her father.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Protestant, I grew up in the Baptist Church.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I believe that the book of Revelation is a literal prophecy of the future. So I have created a new denomination of Christianity.
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Protestant, I grew up in the Baptist Church.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I believe in one God, but if you want things to get done, it has to be in Jesus' name.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I know for a fact God and Jesus are real.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, The voice was very powerful. It asked me why I should live.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, My youngest daughter has a special purpose here on Earth.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I am only alive because of my youngest daughter, and I am to help guide her to fulfill her destiny.

elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I have founded The Church of Revelation Science.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I am more spiritual and truly believe that our souls are eternal and this plane of existence is temporary.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, The experience is very vivid in my memory.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I told my wife two weeks before Hamas attacked Israel, that something big was going to happen in Israel and it would change the world.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: To make a prayer to God work, you must ask in Jesus' name.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, Just from watching TV shows.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was real. I have been telling people about it since I awakened from the coma.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I have a much different view of the Bible and all religion.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, The actual experience for me was like 2 minutes. I was in a coma for 6 days.
